title: PlanReviewCoachInput
description: INPUT of `plan_review_coach`: the decide op's verdict partition, the coach prompt's raw move picks (`notes`), and the coverage pieces (DET coverage + routing) + ticket id/type for the assembled plan_review_verdict.

provider_provenance.description: Provider provenance record from the Pass-2 verify agent step (resolved provider/model, the endpoint actually called, the effective capability record). Carried onto the verdict, never recomputed here. Null when the runner resolved no provider (e.g. the fake runner) — the verdict then omits the key.

outcome_counts.description: The decide op's single-run {clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable} tally, threaded into verdict coverage.

notes.description: The Pass-4 coach prompt's raw notes: [{move_id, subject, finding_refs}].
